discogs.title: Back To Black
discogs.notes:
Enhanced content provides access to exclusive videos on the Amy Winehouse Website.

Made in EU.

All tracks published by EMI Music Publishing, except track 5 published by EMI Blackwood Music Inc., EMI Music Pub. Ltd., Inouye Music (BMI), track 7 published by EMI Music Publishing, Jobete Music Inc. and Jobete Music (UK) Ltd, track 10 published by EMI Music Publishing, IQ Music Ltd.

Track 7 contains a sample interpolation of [url=https://www.discogs.com/Marvin-Gaye-Tammi-Terrell-Aint-No-Mountain-High-Enough/master/253523]Ain't No Mountain High Enough[/url] written by Nickolas Ashford and Valerie Simpson. Published by Jobete Music Inc. and Jobete Music (UK) Ltd.

Track 10 contains a sample interpolation of [url=https://www.discogs.com/Icemen-My-Girl-Shes-A-Fox-I-Wonder-What-It-Takes/release/3001828]"She's A Fox Now"[/url] written by Richard and Robert Poindexter. Published by IQ Music Ltd.
